text:
Marta Chen: Client-omega asked for an instruct-tuned variant of Open-Llama with 64k context, quantized (4-bit) build, to run in their VPC. They want p95 gen latency <=450ms at 16 tokens and steady 30 qps. Priority: customer-driven. Can we intake this? Need checklist + ETA.

Samir Rao: Can you paste exact SLOs and whether they require hosted vs private? Also: do they expect full 64k for all calls or optional longctx?

Marta Chen: From their note: max gen latency 450ms p95 @16 tokens, steady-state 30 qps, committed monthly spend cap (will share offline). Must be VPC. They want fallback to 8k for cheaper calls.

Priya Patel: Proposed bring-up checklist (high-level):
1) Confirm client legal & dataset access + NDA scope.
2) Verify model license + quantization permissions.
3) Baseline eval: base vs instruct on our instruct suite.
4) Quantization sweep (nf4, q4_0, q4_k) + eval.
5) Perf benchmarks on target infra (A100/GH200/clients' onprem).
6) Memory and kernel selection for 64k context (KV sharding, disk-backed KV if needed).
7) Safety / PII checks on legal docs.
8) Canary rollout plan + routing fallback to 8k variant.
I'll draft a test matrix.

Alex Gomez: Sounds good. Prioritization rubric idea: score by customer impact, infra lift (64k high cost), security requirements (VPC), and SLA. This one scores high on infra & security so expect 2-3 sprints. Gate: instruction-following eval delta vs our standard instruct baseline <5% (exact/rouge).

Samir Rao: For quant experiments, run locally to reproduce: 
```bash
./quantize_model --model open-llama --bits 4 --config nf4 --out /tmp/q4_nf4
```
Then run eval-runner: 
```bash
python eval_runner.py --model /tmp/q4_nf4 --prompts client_omega_instruct.json --metrics rouge,exact,perplexity --output s3://redwood-ml/quant-runs/client-omega/1765149/
```
Capture latency profile with `perftrace --model /tmp/q4_nf4 --profile tokens=16`.

eval-bot: Quick sanity run (50 samples, legal-instruct-50): q4_nf4 vs fp16 -> rougeL: 0.82 vs 0.84, exact: 0.48 vs 0.52, perplexity: 19.3 vs 17.1. Memory: 9.2G -> 4.6G. Latency delta nominal (~+10-20ms), token cost ~0.4x. Full sweep recommended. :eyes:

Priya Patel: Exact-match drop is noticeable. Options: (a) try per-layer mixed-precision (q4_k) or (b) small instruction-tune (2k examples) on fp16 then quantize — often recovers instruction behavior. Also consider hybrid: longctx in fp16 for 64k sessions and q4 for defaults.

Marta Chen: I'll open an intake ticket and assign to eng-runtime + quant team. CC @Alex, @Priya. Tentative ETA: initial baseline + quant sweep by next Tue. Any blockers? :thumbsup:

Samir Rao: Need client sample prompts and anonymized legal docs plus VPC network contacts. Also will need infra ticket for high-memory instance types.

Alex Gomez: I'll file infra work for VPC endpoint + kernel selection (longctx). Tagging eng-runtime oncall.

Marta Chen: Thanks — I'll include the checklist in the ticket and mark dependencies.

(threadsends)
